title: async and await
description:
Each function takes a list of ids and `fetchOne(id)`, which returns a promise:

```javascript
async function loadInOrder(ids, fetchOne) { }  // one at a time, in order; returns the values
async function loadAll(ids, fetchOne) { }      // all at the same time; returns the values in id order
async function loadSafely(ids, fetchOne) { }   // all at the same time; never rejects
```

`loadInOrder` and `loadAll` reject with the first error. `loadSafely` returns `{ loaded, failed }`: the values of the successful ids in id order, and the ids that failed, in id order.
hints: `await` inside a `for...of` loop waits for each id before starting the next; `Promise.all(ids.map(...))` starts them all first.
`Promise.allSettled` gives one outcome per id, in id order, so the index tells you which id failed.
